blocks.text: National University-Archipelago Builders bounced back from a third-set stumble to overpower VNS-Always Bright in four sets, 25-14, 25-13, 20-25, 25-12, and open its campaign in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on a winning note on Tuesday at the Mall of Asia Arena.
